hydrogen.location: Table 1, printed page 190; method and uncertainty on the same page
hydrogen.definition: Mutual diffusion measured by Taylor dispersion in the named carrier gas; compare with carrier-dominated trace limit.
hydrogen.uncertainty: Author estimates about +/-2%; confidence level unspecified. Do not reduce by sqrt(number of repeats).

series.detector: All repeats tungsten TCD; other entries semiconductor except flagged H2-N2 entries.

oh_air.location: Primary article abstract; full experimental composition not yet qualified
oh_air.qualification: Exploratory: exact air composition not established. Evaluate 21/79 and bounds for any N2/O2 bath; do not extrapolate measurement to flame temperatures.
oh_air.nist_note: Separate rounded evaluated value in NIST TN2279 Table 1a at 298 K; no uncertainty assigned here.

later_study.method: OH-air inferred by Blanc's law from OH-He and a 0.7/0.3 He/air mixture. Synthetic air composition not quantified in article text.
later_study.limits: Separate measurement and temperature from Ivanov 2007; do not pool. Reported OH-air study range 243-318 K, not flame temperatures.
later_study.polar_analogue: Authors compare measured OH with H2O diffusion calculated from effective Lennard-Jones parameters. This is not the stock GRI30 H2O parameter set.

nist_fits.location: Table 1a; ln(D[cm2/s]) = A + B/T[K] + C*ln(T[K]); p = 101325 Pa
nist_fits.kind: NIST evaluated reference fits; not individual experimental measurements
nist_fits.uncertainty: Printed percent ranges vary with temperature; use the upper value only as a descriptive envelope, not a 95% interval.
